title: fix: recover agents from invalid session-store registrations
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Configured agents can remain degraded after deferred startup when the database registry contains a physical path derived from the `(multiple)` session-store marker.

Fixes #169764.

## User Impact

Gateway startup warns and skips unrelated registrations while inspecting configured database candidates and preparing admitted agents. Unreadable configured paths retain their inspection refusal, allowing isolatable failures to leave healthy agents running. Standalone `openclaw doctor --fix` removes bogus sentinel registrations on every platform, deletes only empty files, and reports retained data-bearing or unreadable files. Active and candidate update passes preserve the updater's captured rollback inventory; rerun standalone Doctor after the update for cleanup.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reject sentinel and unresolved template selectors before path normalization. The concrete-path helper lives in the lightweight SQLite target-path module, so resolver consumers do not acquire the broader `paths.ts` dependency. Preflight uses captured candidate paths and explicit ownership claims without opening runtime stores merely to filter registry rows. Physical alias checks treat missing and non-directory paths as non-concrete while preserving exact configured claims for inspection.

The collision owner supplies already-resolved physical targets to the canonical-target resolver, removing duplicate ownership resolution. Doctor shares registration removal with Windows alias repair; empty sentinel files are deleted and other files are retained with their path reported. The unused internal repair-report export and redundant ownership/removal scans are removed. Total production diff: **+163 / -123, net +40**. Test diff: **+147 / -11, net +136**.

## Evidence

**CI comparison for `1af90edab982`**

Fetched each failed job log once from [CI run 38295158018](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38295158018): ten test jobs and the aggregate gate, containing 58 distinct failing cases in 13 files. CI tested merge `97b16cdfaf3e` against main `3ab5c426c67b`. Local comparisons use that exact unchanged main source and the PR head.

All 48 runtime-config failure cases reproduce on the unchanged CI base and pass on the PR head. Main's `7e48efba1047` (#169714) changed `getRuntimeConfig()` into a prepared-snapshot-only read. The startup-index cases fail in fixture session writes before preflight starts; the billing/rate-limit cases fail in the embedded-run path. The concrete-path helper has no runtime-config dependency, and preflight candidate capture already consumes its supplied configuration. Completing the async configuration handoff belongs at those session/embedded-run entrypoints; changing the path helper would address the wrong owner.

The four browser failures also reproduce on the unchanged base: #170082 introduced `rowMode: "sidebar"`, while this test expects `"compact"`. All four pass on the PR head. The historical-transcript Doctor assertion and four schema-cache assertions fail on both sources. The baseline Doctor replay additionally encounters a missing generated Discord fixture directory; that extra capsule-only failure is separate from the CI assertion.

This triage changes no production code or tests. The previous type, lint, Madge, and Codex review evidence still applies to the unchanged head. Production/test LOC remains net **+40 / +136**.

Workshop's missing `💾 Learned:` announcement reproduces on the unchanged base with the same diagnostic as CI: one review request retains the final foreground receipt, `changes` is empty, and provider errors are empty. The PR head passes the complete case. The precise upstream review-lifecycle defect remains unisolated; this replay is attribution evidence, not a claimed Workshop repair. CI took 135.856 seconds for the case; the unchanged base took 149.959 seconds (189.91 seconds file wall / 194.71 seconds command wall), while the head case passed in 68.528 seconds. Cold Gateway imports and the existing 80-second notice wait account for much of this integration cost; no timeout or assertion changed.

All 13 failing files were replayed locally on both sources. Head: **208 passed / 5 inherited failures**. Base: **154 passed / 59 failures**, comprising all **58 exact CI failures** plus the generated Discord fixture artifact error noted above.

An initial default E2E preparation entered full SDK declaration generation and was cancelled after 1447.11 seconds before test execution; only this lane's verified wrapper/tree was stopped. The successful baseline Workshop route matches CI: `OPENCLAW_BUILD_PRIVATE_QA=1 VITEST=1 node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs scripts/build-all.mts qaRuntime` completed in 55.7 seconds, then `OPENCLAW_E2E_USE_PREBUILT_DIST=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.e2e.config.ts src/gateway/gateway-workshop-learning.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`. The head's default build preparation took 336.2 seconds within its 471.03-second command. These preparation costs are recorded separately from the test case times.

<details>
<summary>Earlier focused and static proof on the unchanged head</summary>

- Final-code focused/consumer runs: **184 passed; 5 failures reproduced on unchanged CI base**, across 14 files. All five consumer mock suites pass, including ACP (46/46), status and agent commands (29/29), session-key resolution (16/16), and queue health (2/2). Resolver/target/path suites pass 51/51; preflight, startup preparation, and Doctor pass 24/24. The final focused Gateway deferral case passes (118.593 seconds test time, 240.83 seconds file wall time, 257.75 seconds wrapper wall time under concurrent local typechecking).
- Fresh isolated Codex review is clean at P0–P2; final Madge reports zero cycles. Targeted lint/format, production typechecking, and all 28 test-type shards pass. The fresh `check:changed` run passes every stage before the inherited `TransactionRecipes` dead export; all 12 later stages were executed separately and pass. Both import-cycle checks report zero cycles.
- Verified source head: `1af90edab9829995cd92131b0e97b8beccea929e`.

- Fetched each of the seven failed job logs once from CI run [38285475195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38285475195). The missing-export failures and ACP pending-dispatch timeouts came from the new low-level resolver depending on a mocked `paths.ts` module. The helper now stays below that mock boundary; consumer mocks are unchanged. The legacy-schema fixture now points at the configured canonical database and retains its schema-refusal and unchanged-artifact assertions.
- CI tested merge `b1403f0f` against main `34627e99`, rather than the PR head alone. The exact base UI source reproduces `chat-composer-disabled-banner.test.ts(38,11): TS2322: Mock<Procedure> is not assignable to undefined`; its new test block came from `a640fff46b13`. The base source capsule also reports missing generated declarations; this is diagnostic reproduction of the exact UI error, not a clean baseline typecheck claim.
- On unchanged CI base `34627e99`, the two SQLite failure files reproduce all four schema-cache assertions in `openclaw-state-db-cron-delivery-migration.test.ts` and the cold-maintenance assertion in `startup-migration.registry-recovery.test.ts`: **5 failed / 15 passed**, 190.38 seconds for the test shard and 340.01 seconds for the wrapper, including 130.37 seconds of worker preparation. These are extra schema/catalog reads and two canonical-main-key reads against tests requiring none. The separate `re-registers durable lineage children before configured-only runtime reads` failure reached native `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` with `database is locked` in CI (7.055 seconds). It passes once on the unchanged base (5.192 seconds) and once on the final code (4.015 seconds). Writer contention is observed, but its ownership/fixture-lifetime cause is not isolated; this needs a separate investigation and is not a claimed repair.
- Before the final ownership-deduplication refactor, the complete Gateway lifecycle file passed **13/13**, 359.14 seconds wall time; worker/recover took **55.129 seconds** and forced deferral took **32.072 seconds**. On unchanged original base `6fa67453`, worker/recover previously passed in **87.776 seconds** (223.239 seconds wrapper wall time). Existing cold startup and host contention dominate these timings; no timeout or retry was increased.
- The canonical-key scale test previously reproduced its existing 60-second child timeout on unchanged original base: **78.652 seconds** test time, **127.066 seconds** wall time, versus **71.403 seconds** in the patch's original importer run. The diagnostic cleanup experiment was reverted. The original bulk importer run stopped after 144 passing tests; later importer shards were not executed.
- The `TransactionRecipes` dead export is inherited from #169933 and fixed on main by `4cdac89cf0b6`; this PR leaves that file untouched.

</details>
